anodized-chainmail.name: Anodized chainmail (instanced interlocked metal mesh)
anodized-chainmail.oneLine: A full-bleed substrate woven from interlocked chrome rings with an anodized

atmosphere-rim-glow.name: Atmosphere rim glow
atmosphere-rim-glow.oneLine: A matte near-black body whose EDGE carries a thin scattering glow - the planet-limb optic applied to surfaces: dark mass, luminous rim, void beyond.

azulejo-painted-tile.name: Azulejo Painted Tile (hand-brushed cobalt on glazed tile grid)
azulejo-painted-tile.oneLine: A wall of glazed tiles painted by hand in cobalt on milk white: everything - scrolling rocaille borders, cartouche frames, architectural scenes, even letterforms - is BRUSHWORK sitting under a soft tin-glaze sheen, and the whole surface is divided by a faint grout-seam grid that runs straight through the painting.

bioluminescent-membrane.name: Bioluminescent membrane
bioluminescent-membrane.oneLine: A translucent organic tissue that reacts to light: inverted - it IS the light source; subsurface glow pulses slowly from within, falling off into true black with no ambient fill.

brushed-aluminum.name: Brushed Aluminum (anisotropic metal)
brushed-aluminum.oneLine: A semi-gloss surface that reacts to light: yes - anisotropic highlight perpendicular to brush direction.

cardboard-box-print.name: Cardboard Box Print (one-ink screenprint on box board)
cardboard-box-print.oneLine: Printed corrugated packaging as a design system: the box-board color IS the field, everything on it is a single utility ink, and the layout follows die-line and shipping-label logic.

ceramic-glaze.name: Ceramic Glaze (high-gloss porcelain finish)
ceramic-glaze.oneLine: A glossy surface that reacts to light: yes - sharp specular sweep.

chromatic-aberration-lens.name: Lens Chromatic Aberration (radial RGB split toward corners)
chromatic-aberration-lens.oneLine: A glossy surface that reacts to light: yes - CA peaks at high-contrast luminance transitions.

chrome-mirror.name: Chrome Mirror (Y2K chromecore / cyber-sigil)
chrome-mirror.oneLine: A metallic surface that reacts to light: yes - environment reflection, hue shift with angle.

chrome-on-velvet.name: Chrome on Velvet (Y2K luxury substrate)
chrome-on-velvet.oneLine: A metallic (chrome) on matte (velvet) surface that reacts to light: yes - strong.

corduroy.name: Corduroy (ribbed pile fabric)
corduroy.oneLine: A matte surface that reacts to light: yes - directional pile reflects per-rib and deforms: yes.

crt-phosphor.name: CRT Phosphor (raster scan with subpixel RGB)
crt-phosphor.oneLine: A glossy surface that reacts to light: yes - phosphor glow blooms with viewing angle.

datamosh-compression-smear.name: Datamosh (codec interpolation failure)
datamosh-compression-smear.oneLine: A matte surface and deforms: yes - frame motion stretches old pixels along predicted vectors.

decollage-poster-layers.name: Decollage Poster Layers (stratified torn billboard skins)
decollage-poster-layers.oneLine: A stratigraphy of pasted poster skins: hand-rips expose older ink layers beneath, and type survives only as cropped fragments.

denim.name: Denim (twill weave, indigo fade)
denim.oneLine: A matte surface and deforms: yes - soft drape.

dispersion-prism-glass.name: Dispersion prism glass
dispersion-prism-glass.oneLine: A glossy transparent surface that reacts to light: yes - refraction SPLITS into spectral rainbow at edges and thick sections (chromatic dispersion), casting small caustic rainbows onto surfaces behind.

embroidery-stitch.name: Embroidery Stitch (hand-stitched thread on quilted fabric)
embroidery-stitch.oneLine: Sparse hand stitches on a fabric ground: letterforms drawn in chain-stitch and backstitch thread, rules and dividers as dashed running stitches, and panels bounded by quilted padded seams - every line visibly made of short thread segments with a soft raised profile.

felt.name: Felt (matted wool, fuzzy)
felt.oneLine: A matte surface and deforms: yes - squashes on press.

filament-strand-ribbon.name: Filament strand ribbon (fiber-optic hairlines in flow)
filament-strand-ribbon.oneLine: Hundreds-to-thousands of 1px luminous strands traveling together as one silk

film-grain-cinestill-800t.name: Film Grain - CineStill 800T (tungsten, halation, neon glow)
film-grain-cinestill-800t.oneLine: A matte surface that reacts to light: yes - bright lights bloom with red halation.

film-grain-tri-x.name: Film Grain - Tri-X 400 (B&W, coarse grain)
film-grain-tri-x.oneLine: A matte surface that reacts to light: yes - grain heavier in shadows.

forged-steel-ember.name: Forged Steel Ember (incandescent heat-gradient metal)
forged-steel-ember.surfaceFinish: matte (mill scale) with emissive incandescent passages
forged-steel-ember.oneLine: Iron under the hammer: matte scale-black steel that glows from within along a strict heat ramp - black through dull red, cherry, orange, to white heat - with spark showers and flaking mill scale.

frosted-glass.name: Frosted Glass (canonical glassmorphism)
frosted-glass.oneLine: A glossy surface (translucent) that reacts to light: yes - top-edge specular highlight, tinted by substrate beneath.

glaze-drip-run.name: Glaze Drip Run (gravity-run cobalt glaze on porcelain)
glaze-drip-run.surfaceFinish: glossy (runny glaze) over matte porous shelf
glaze-drip-run.oneLine: Ceramic glaze caught mid-run: deep cobalt flowing down chalk-white ware under kiln gravity, thinning to translucent sapphire at the top, gathering into runny beads and drip fingers along lower edges, and stopping in glassy pooled feet just before the shelf - the material's entire story is WHERE THE FLOW STOPPED.

glossy-plastic-aqua.name: Glossy Plastic (Frutiger Aero / Apple Aqua / Windows Vista wet button)
glossy-plastic-aqua.oneLine: A glossy surface that reacts to light: yes - single top-half specular gloss and deforms: minor on press (inner shadow grows).

guilloche-security-print.name: Guilloche Security Print (passport / banknote engraving system)
guilloche-security-print.surfaceFinish: matte (crisp security paper) with embossed leather cover accents
guilloche-security-print.oneLine: Security-document printing as a surface language: guilloche microline lattices tint the paper, display type is engraved with hatched strokes, machine-readable OCR-B rows anchor the data layer, and visa stamps scatter across it in their own inks.

hand-architect-sketch.name: Hand Architect Sketch (Le Corbusier / Frank Lloyd Wright register)
hand-architect-sketch.oneLine: A matte surface that reacts to light: subtle - paper grain breathes under raking light.

hand-processed-filmstrip.name: Hand-Processed Filmstrip (sprockets, scratches, chemical bloom)
hand-processed-filmstrip.oneLine: The physical film strip as interface chrome: sprocket-hole rails frame every component, and hand-processing artifacts - scratches, chemical stains, light leaks, burnt edges - become the surface treatment.

iso-line-drawing.name: Isometric Line Drawing (axonometric vector, no fill)

jacquard-embroidery.name: Jacquard Embroidery (gold-thread brocade on midnight silk)
jacquard-embroidery.surfaceFinish: lustrous (metallic weft on matte silk ground)
jacquard-embroidery.oneLine: A woven surface where imagery and letterforms are BUILT AS THREAD: dense gold weft stitches assemble birds, borders and display type row by row on a midnight silk ground, every motif showing its individual stitch texture, with punch-card dot rows as the loom's visible instruction motif.

led-segment-display.name: LED Segment Display (lit segments over ghost cells)
led-segment-display.surfaceFinish: matte black polymer chassis with emissive segments
led-segment-display.oneLine: Segmented LED typography as hardware: seven- and fourteen-segment digits glow red, amber, or green with soft bloom, while the UNLIT segments stay faintly visible as ghost cells on a matte black polymer chassis.

linen-weave.name: Linen Weave (Apple-linen / textbook substrate)
linen-weave.oneLine: A matte surface and deforms: yes - fabric drapes.

liquid-glass.name: Liquid Glass (Apple WWDC25)
liquid-glass.oneLine: A glossy surface (transparent) that reacts to light: yes - specular highlight tracks tilt/pointer; chromatic edge and deforms: minor on press.

marble.name: Marble (veined stone)
marble.oneLine: A glossy (polished) or matte (honed) surface that reacts to light: yes - soft sheen.

marker-stroke-frame.name: Marker stroke frame (hand-drawn containment outlines)
marker-stroke-frame.oneLine: Thick, imperfect marker/crayon strokes used as CONTAINMENT - each item in a

material-tonal-surface.name: Material 3 Tonal Surface (dynamic-color elevation)
material-tonal-surface.oneLine: A matte surface that reacts to light: yes via subtle tint shift on elevation.

matte-clay.name: Matte Clay (claymorphism)
matte-clay.oneLine: A matte surface that reacts to light: yes - inset highlight + dark inset shadow and deforms: minor on press (squash).

mezzotint-plate.name: Mezzotint Plate (burnished highlights out of velvet black)
mezzotint-plate.oneLine: A darkness-first printmaking surface: the plate is rocked entirely to black, and every form is polished back toward light.

monospace-code-grid.name: Monospace Code Grid (IDE / terminal text as visual material)

neon-glass-tube.name: Neon Glass Tube (hand-bent gas-discharge craft object)
neon-glass-tube.surfaceFinish: glossy glass tube, self-emissive discharge core
neon-glass-tube.oneLine: Real bent-glass neon: letterforms are one continuous tube of constant gauge, script drawn in a single stroke with round glass-radius bends, terminated by red electrode caps, powered by visible transformer hardware - the halation glow belongs to a physical object, not a filter.

nes-rom-corruption.name: NES ROM Corruption (palette-flipped sprites, garbled tile data)
nes-rom-corruption.oneLine: A matte surface and deforms: yes (tiles re-index, palette swaps).

nixie-glow.name: Nixie Glow (gas-discharge digits in glass envelopes)
nixie-glow.surfaceFinish: glossy glass envelope over matte blackened-steel chassis
nixie-glow.oneLine: Laboratory-counter digits: each glass envelope holds a physical stack of shaped wire cathodes - one digit lit in incandescent orange, the others visible as layered dark silhouettes behind and in front of it - fronted by a fine anode mesh, mounted on blackened steel with engraved label plates.

paper-construction.name: Paper construction (die-cut strata / pop-up volume)
paper-construction.oneLine: Paper as BUILT VOLUME, not surface texture: stacked sheets of colored stock

paper-marbling-ebru.name: Paper Marbling Ebru (combed floated-pigment print)
paper-marbling-ebru.oneLine: A matte one-contact print: pigment floats on a thickened bath, is dragged into figures with a comb or stylus, then lifts onto paper in a single touch - crisp swirl edges, stone rings, and fine granular speckle frozen mid-flow.

paper-with-watercolor.name: Paper with Watercolor (botanical illustration substrate)
paper-with-watercolor.oneLine: A matte surface (translucent (washes)) and deforms: yes.

parchment.name: Parchment / Vellum (animal hide, premium document)
parchment.oneLine: A matte surface and deforms: yes - curls dramatically at corners.

patchwork-quilt.name: Patchwork Quilt (hand-pieced fabric assembly)
patchwork-quilt.oneLine: A surface ASSEMBLED from mismatched fabric patches - washed chambray, ticking stripe, worn black twill, cream laundry cloth - each patch cut with pinked zigzag edges, joined by visible red running-stitch seams, and labeled with sewn cloth tags carrying handwriting and stamped caps.

pebbled-leather.name: Pebbled Leather (luxury goods finish)
pebbled-leather.oneLine: A semi-gloss surface that reacts to light: yes - per-pebble micro-highlight and deforms: yes - bends.

pencil-graphite.name: Pencil Graphite (HB to 6B sketch)
pencil-graphite.oneLine: A matte surface (translucent) that reacts to light: yes - graphite glints at angle.

reeded-fluted-glass.name: Reeded / fluted glass (vertical-slat refraction)
reeded-fluted-glass.oneLine: A glossy transparent panel of vertical half-cylinder ribs - each rib acts as a

rgb-channel-split.name: RGB Channel Split (intentional large-displacement chromatic split)
rgb-channel-split.oneLine: A matte surface that reacts to light: yes - displacement amount can react to pointer / tilt.

risograph-glass.name: Risograph-Glass (frosted glass under riso grain)
risograph-glass.oneLine: A matte surface (translucent) that reacts to light: minimal.

scanned-glass.name: Scanned Glass (digital glass on analog paper substrate)
scanned-glass.oneLine: A glossy surface (translucent) that reacts to light: yes.

schematic-pcb-trace.name: Schematic / PCB Trace (circuit-board aesthetic)
schematic-pcb-trace.oneLine: A matte surface that reacts to light: minor - gold pads catch raking light.

sheer-silk-overlap.name: Sheer Silk Overlap (translucent fields that mix color)
sheer-silk-overlap.oneLine: Layered planes of sheer dyed silk - indigo, madder red, saffron - stretched taut against light, each field translucent on its own and optically MIXING wherever two overlap: indigo over saffron yields violet, madder over indigo a deep plum, the crossings becoming new named colors with crisp straight edges.

signal-interference.name: Signal Interference (hum bars, sync errors, vertical hold drift)
signal-interference.oneLine: A glossy surface that reacts to light: yes - interference modulates with content luminance and deforms: yes (frame skew, scroll, sync loss).

silk.name: Silk (lustrous fabric)
silk.oneLine: A semi-gloss surface that reacts to light: yes - anisotropic lustre and deforms: yes - flowing drape.

smoked-obsidian-glass.name: Smoked obsidian glass (dark refractor over typography)
smoked-obsidian-glass.oneLine: A dark, smoky, glossy glass solid - cube, shard, blob - whose whole job is to

smooth-leather.name: Smooth Leather (full-grain, polished)
smooth-leather.oneLine: A semi-gloss surface that reacts to light: yes - soft specular sweep and deforms: yes.

soft-ui-foam.name: Soft UI / Neumorphic Foam
soft-ui-foam.oneLine: A matte surface that reacts to light: yes - dual highlight + shadow and deforms: yes (raised ↔ pressed).

split-flap-board.name: Split-Flap Board (mechanical per-character flap cells)
split-flap-board.surfaceFinish: matte (printed plastic flaps) with brushed-steel frame
split-flap-board.oneLine: Departure-board typography: every character lives in its own hinged flap cell with a visible horizontal split line at mid-height, mounted in a steel frame - text changes by physically flipping through the character drum.

stipple-dot-field.name: Stipple Dot Field (variable-density ink dots as the medium)
stipple-dot-field.surfaceFinish: matte (crisp ink dots on warm paper)
stipple-dot-field.oneLine: Pointillist print-register where the dot is the only mark: letterforms, borders, fills, and flow-lines are all built from fields of crisp ink dots whose DENSITY carries weight, tone, and emphasis on warm paper.

stitched-garment.name: Stitched Garment (tailored construction chrome on dark silk)
stitched-garment.surfaceFinish: matte (fine silk nap with metallic hardware)
stitched-garment.oneLine: Garment CONSTRUCTION as interface chrome: near-black tailored silk panels bounded by dashed stitch channels, with functional gold drawcords threaded through concealed channels, brass eyelets as terminals, and cord ends marking state - the atelier's engineering made visible as thin luminous hardware on darkness.

suminagashi-marbling.name: Suminagashi Marbling (monochrome ink-ring drift)
suminagashi-marbling.oneLine: A matte monochrome print of ink floated on still water: concentric rings widen from each dropped touch, currents pull the rings into feathered filaments, and the whole drift lifts onto white paper as veils of indigo-black over vast quiet margins.

terracotta-earthenware.name: Terracotta Earthenware (unglazed fired clay with coil logic)
terracotta-earthenware.oneLine: Real fired earth: rough unglazed clay surfaces with granular pore texture and pit flecks, banded courses laid like coil construction, seams of slip-white rope between them, and an earthen palette running terracotta through raw clay, umber and wet-clay dark to dry sand and slip white.

thin-glass-chip.name: Thin Glass Chip (iOS-style toggle, Control Center pill)
thin-glass-chip.oneLine: A glossy surface (translucent) that reacts to light: yes - but lighter than full glass; substrate shows through more.

torn-edge.name: Torn Edge (paper / fabric / film)
torn-edge.oneLine: A matte surface and deforms: yes.

vhs-distortion.name: VHS Distortion (chromatic aberration + scanlines + bleed)
vhs-distortion.oneLine: A glossy surface and deforms: yes - tape head distortion bands.

vhs-frutiger.name: VHS-Frutiger (Frutiger Aero with VHS distortion)
vhs-frutiger.oneLine: A glossy surface (translucent) that reacts to light: yes and deforms: yes - VHS tracking bars.

volumetric-cloud.name: Volumetric cloud / cotton
volumetric-cloud.oneLine: A matte volumetric mass (translucent at wisps) that reacts to light: yes - silver-lining rim where lit, soft self-shadowed underbelly; and deforms: yes - billows and drifts continuously, edges never hold a fixed silhouette.

volumetric-light-shaft.name: Volumetric light shaft (god rays raking a dark stage)
volumetric-light-shaft.oneLine: Light treated as a MATERIAL occupying air: soft parallel shafts entering a

washi-kozo-fiber.name: Washi Kozo Fiber (long-fibered craft paper with fold scoring)
washi-kozo-fiber.oneLine: Handmade kozo-fiber paper whose long embedded strands stay visible in the sheet - fine pale filaments wandering through both the vermilion-dyed and natural-white grounds - scored by crisp fold creases that catch light as thin ridge lines, in a craft palette of vermilion, gold leaf dots, sumi black and warm paper grey.

weathered-leather.name: Weathered Leather (vintage, distressed)
weathered-leather.oneLine: A matte surface that reacts to light: minor specular at non-worn areas and deforms: yes - creases at handle points.

wireframe-3d-line.name: Wireframe 3D (Tron-style line-only volumetric)
wireframe-3d-line.oneLine: A matte (or glowing) surface (transparent) that reacts to light: yes - lines can glow with bloom.

wood-grain-walnut.name: Wood Grain (walnut, dark, vertical grain)
wood-grain-walnut.oneLine: A semi-gloss (varnished) or matte (raw) surface that reacts to light: yes - anisotropic along grain.
